capabilities: Read local EPUBs by chapter or continuous scrolling
Highlight text and add notes while reading
Save highlights as Markdown notes with links back to passages
Browse a table of contents and search the whole book
Resume reading position and restore annotations when reopening a book
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Designed for reflowable EPUBs; iOS and Android host testing is still pending. No cloud services or telemetry. Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read EPUB files or turn highlights from a book into linked Markdown notes.
summary: EPUB reader that opens local e-books inside Obsidian and saves highlights and annotations as Markdown notes linked back to the text.
